answer.read: Edelstahl-Service Donautal opened at a price well above today's contract price and our last orders (a5, evidence:orders), justifying it with index rises. However, its material is covered at fixed prices until March 2027 (doc:20260706-70710-M1), and AS-14404 actually fell over the summer (a1). It also proposes an index clause (doc:20260912-70710-P08), which signals concern about later material risk. Its delivery has slipped below our target (a2, sc:70710@2026Q3), and quality ppm has worsened. It is an incumbent with a framework that rolls over, so it wants continuity. Status is open after one reply.
answer.message: Thank you for your offer. We cannot follow a step up from the price we have been paying, particularly as your material is covered until next spring and the alloy surcharge has eased recently. Your on-time delivery has also fallen short of what we expect. We propose the attached sheet, which gives you a longer commitment in exchange for a sharper price and extended payment terms.
answer.reason: E0 is the only selectable option; every alternative mix has unknown trade values and cannot be chosen. E0 gives a large C reduction against the opening quote. The longer term offers the volume security an incumbent values. Order history, the index decline and the delivery record are the strongest factual levers. The volume argument was dropped because a modest rise in our demand forecast adds little.
